preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'MF' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the input string s is either 'M' or 'F'.

postconditions.description: The output is 0 if the input string s contains only boys or only girls.
The output is the number of seconds needed to move all the girls in the line in front of the boys.
